steps.text: Shuffle the Early War cards and deal {n} to each player; The China Card faceup in front of the USSR player
steps.note: You may look at your cards before placing Influence

steps.text: USSR sets up first, 15 Influence: 1 Syria, 1 Iraq, 3 North Korea, 3 East Germany, 1 Finland, 6 anywhere in Eastern Europe
US sets up second, 20 Influence: 1 each in Iran, Israel, Japan, Australia, Philippines, South Korea, Panama and South Africa, 5 in the United Kingdom, 7 anywhere in Western Europe
Space Race markers left of the Space Race track; Military OP markers on 0
Turn marker on turn 1, DEFCON marker on 5, VP marker on 0
Turn 4: shuffle the Mid War deck into the draw pile and hand size becomes 9; turn 8: shuffle in the Late War deck
Scoring cards must be played during the turn they are drawn
